categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches 'Build system' label, modifies .github/workflows/ci.yml, and updates minimum supported macOS toolchain requirements.
categories.rationale: Bumping the minimum Xcode Command Line Tools version establishes an LLVM-19 baseline following macOS Sonoma's EOL. As stated by the author, upgrading CLT to 26.3 'will allow to use C++20 CTAD and also allow switching the project to C++23', providing worthwhile leverage for future toolchain and language modernizations.

categories.name: docs
categories.evidence: The documentation updates in doc/ are subordinate to the build and CI toolchain bump.
categories.rationale: Documentation changes purely document the minimum toolchain update and include release notes, which follow from the build change rather than representing a primary documentation effort.
